headline: GroundedGEO tests evidence-aware ranking against unsupported but relevant-looking text
summary: GroundedGEO studies whether generative search rankers can elevate relevant-looking product text without evidence support. In a 50-query e-commerce benchmark, the authors report an unsupported-rich ranking gain on frozen Qwen2.5-7B, with the effect marginal on one other ranker and absent on a third. An oracle-label reranker reduced attack-arm top-three rates in the paper's controlled experiment, but every tested automatic judge failed a preregistered reliability gate and the human-gold arm has unresolved interpretation. The authors do not establish a validated automatic defense or a web-wide effect.
